$comment: feat.deathwave (FEAT-087) death-queue smoothing configuration, extending engine.citizens' Gompertz-Makeham mortality (mortality.go). Every numeric value below is a PLACEHOLDER pending Aaron's balance pass (the standing balance-number regime, Vestige metropolis-balance-number-regime — same convention as data/fertility.json/data/census.json) — tests check direction/shape only (a smooth ~N/month tail, never a 2% one-month population cliff), never a pinned magnitude. Spec refs: §5.2 (cold-pass mortality hazard), §9 (seasonality — minor winter health wave, summer water stress; consumed via engine.season, see meta.emergencySource below), §H (health & deathcare — cemetery/crematorium/hearse throughput). Handoff target: FEAT-088 feat.deathservices drains the realised-death queue (funeral throughput as an INJECTED drain capacity, never derived from this file's budget — ASM-580, ADR two independent knobs). inc1 (this file's initial scope) builds only the smoothing-queue core (AC-1..5, AC-12..19); the weather-emergency suspension (AC-6..8, inc2) and the FEAT-088 handoff/injected-drain surface (AC-9..11, inc3) are later increments and do not yet read monthlyEmergencyBudget below.

meta.emergencySource: engine.season (SeasonAPI month-index curves — HealthWaveModifier for winter-shaped months, WaterDemandMultiplier for drought-shaped months); consumed by inc2, not yet by inc1.
meta.balanceRegime: Every numeric entry below is a disclosed placeholder pending Aaron's balance pass. Units are stated per entry. The only spec'd property is directional: ~N deaths/month smooth, never a 2% population cliff.

monthlyDeathBudget.disclosure: placeholder — the maximum number of hazard-selected deaths the smoothing queue may realise in one ordinary (non-emergency) month, pending Aaron's balance pass. Must be a positive integer. The remainder of any month's hazard-selected deaths beyond this cap is RETAINED in the queue (delay, never a cull — §14/§19, GR#12), drained by subsequent months' budget.

monthlyEmergencyBudget.disclosure: placeholder, NOT YET CONSUMED (inc2 scope, ASM-579) — reserved field for the declared-weather-emergency throughput override that will suspend monthlyDeathBudget's cap. 0 is a sentinel meaning "no cap" (realise the full queue) once inc2 wires the emergency declaration through engine.season; inc1 does not read this field.
